001_N: ["Korea. Nineteen fifty-one. A warship's surgeon pulls a bullet out of a soldier's chest.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
002_N: ["Sixteen wounded men. Sixteen operations. Not one of them dies.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
003_N: ["There's just one problem. He's not a surgeon.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
004_N: ["He has never been to medical school. A few months ago, he was a monk.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
005_N: ["His name is Fred Demara. And he has been a lot of people.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
006_N: ["Lawrence, Massachusetts. Fred's father runs the film projectors in the city's theaters.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
007_N: ["The family lives well. Then the Great Depression takes almost everything.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
008_N: ["At sixteen, Fred runs away from home. To become a monk.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
009_N: ["After two years, the monks tell him he's not suited for it.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
010_N: ["So he joins the army. That doesn't suit him either.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
011_N: ["In nineteen forty-two, he borrows an army buddy's name, Anthony Ignolia. And walks away.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
012_N: ["He tries two more monasteries. Then he joins the navy.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
013_N: ["There, he trains as a hospital corpsman. A medic's helper. Remember that.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
014_N: ["The navy won't give him the job he wants.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
016_N: ["And comes back as Doctor Robert Linton French. Psychologist.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
017_FRED: ["Good morning, class. Today, we study the human mind.",{"fish":"48b83695ea7f4b2d8ebcd63a0775a3bd","speed":0.95}]
018_N: ["Doctor French teaches psychology at a college in Pennsylvania.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
019_N: ["He becomes the dean of its School of Philosophy.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
020_N: ["He even publishes a booklet. How to Bring Up Your Child.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
021_N: ["Then come a few forged checks. And Doctor French is gone.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
023_N: ["Eighteen months in a navy prison. For desertion.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
025_N: ["Fred studies law at night. Under a fake name, of course.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
026_N: ["Then he joins a Catholic teaching order in Maine. As Brother John Payne.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
027_N: ["Brother John decides the order needs a college. So he founds one.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
028_N: ["A real college. The state of Maine gives it a charter.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
029_N: ["Then the order doesn't make him its head. So Brother John quits.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
030_N: ["The college survives without him. Today, it's a university in Ohio.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
031_N: ["But before he leaves Maine, Brother John makes a new friend.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
033_FRED: ["Doctor, could I borrow your papers? I'm thinking of studying medicine.",{"fish":"48b83695ea7f4b2d8ebcd63a0775a3bd","speed":0.95}]
035_N: ["Fred studies those papers very closely. Then he disappears with them.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
036_N: ["March, nineteen fifty-one. Saint John, New Brunswick. A navy recruiting office.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
037_FRED: ["Doctor Joseph Cyr. I'd like to serve my country.",{"fish":"48b83695ea7f4b2d8ebcd63a0775a3bd","speed":0.95}]
039_FRED: ["If the navy can't use me, I'm sure the army can. Or the air force.",{"fish":"48b83695ea7f4b2d8ebcd63a0775a3bd","speed":0.95}]
040_N: ["Canada is fighting in Korea. Every service is short of doctors.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
043_N: ["The navy is so happy, nobody asks a single question.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
044_N: ["Three days later, Fred is Surgeon-Lieutenant Joseph Cyr. Royal Canadian Navy.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
045_N: ["His first posting is the naval hospital near Halifax.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
046_N: ["His method is simple. Lots of penicillin. And lots of asking other doctors.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
047_N: ["Colleagues remember a pleasant man. Fairly competent. Not much of a party guy.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
048_N: ["He doesn't approve of how much the other officers drink.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
051_N: ["Fred joins the destroyer H M C S Cayuga. Two hundred men, and one doctor.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
052_N: ["Three days later, the Cayuga sails for Korea.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
053_N: ["At sea, the work is easy. Cuts, sprains, the odd broken bone.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
054_N: ["When a case is new, Doctor Cyr excuses himself. And reads up in his cabin.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
058_N: ["Fred has never pulled a tooth in his life.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
059_N: ["He goes to his cabin. Opens a book. Reads.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
060_N: ["Then he comes back, and pulls the tooth. No fuss.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
062_N: ["Off the coast of Korea, the Cayuga supports a commando raid.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
063_N: ["A boat comes alongside, full of wounded Korean soldiers.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
064_N: ["Sixteen of them. Some will die without surgery.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
066_N: ["Every eye on the ship turns to the only surgeon on board.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
069_FRED: ["Get them into the operating room. Prep them. I'll be right there.",{"fish":"48b83695ea7f4b2d8ebcd63a0775a3bd","speed":0.95}]
070_N: ["Then he goes to his cabin. With a textbook on general surgery.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
072_N: ["He comes out. Scrubs in. And starts cutting.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
073_N: ["Major chest surgery. A bullet, deep in a man's chest.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
075_N: ["When it's over, none of the sixteen has died on his table.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
076_N: ["Years later, some sailors would say it didn't happen quite like that. But the legend sticks.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
078_N: ["The ship's press officer loves this story. He writes it up.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
079_N: ["Soon, newspapers all over Canada are running it.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
080_N: ["Which is a problem. Because one of those papers lands in Grand Falls, New Brunswick.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
081_N: ["Where Doctor Joseph Cyr is seeing patients. The real one.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
082_N: ["Doctor Cyr is startled to read about his own adventures at sea.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
083_CYR: ["That's my name. But I've never been to Korea.",{"fish":"683788ea516848b2ba8f9c2cedbc4b45","speed":0.95}]
084_N: ["October. A signal reaches the Cayuga. Your doctor is an impostor.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
085_N: ["The captain can't believe it. His doctor is capable. And popular.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
089_N: ["The next day, a second signal. No doubt left.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
090_N: ["Fred locks himself in his cabin. Then he gives up.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
091_N: ["He's sent home on a British cruiser, by way of Japan.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
092_N: ["Back in Canada, the navy holds an inquiry.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
095_N: ["The navy fires him. And pays him for his time.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
096_N: ["He goes back to the States. A little richer. And very famous.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
100_N: ["With fake papers, he gets a prison job in Huntsville, Texas.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
101_N: ["Everything goes fine. Until an inmate finds an old copy of Life.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
104_N: ["By now, Fred is a big man. Hard to miss. Bad news for a master of disguise.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
105_N: ["In nineteen fifty-nine, he even goes on Groucho Marx's quiz show. He wins a thousand dollars.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
106_N: ["He says it's going to the Feed and Clothe Fred Demara Fund.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
107_N: ["A bestselling book follows: The Great Impostor. Then Hollywood makes a movie.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
109_N: ["Fred himself gets a small part in another film. As a hospital surgeon.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
110_N: ["The man who fooled a whole navy... can't fool a camera. He's a terrible actor.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
086_N: ["The crew doesn't believe it either. They go to his cabin.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
099_N: ["Which is great for money. And terrible for a man who changes names.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
111_N: ["He becomes a counselor at a rescue mission in Los Angeles.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
112_N: ["He even earns a certificate in Bible studies. A real one, this time.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
113_N: ["In his last years, Fred works as a hospital chaplain in California.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
114_N: ["His past comes out. The chief of staff stands up for him. He stays.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
115_N: ["Fred Demara dies in nineteen eighty-two. He's sixty.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
117_N: ["In nineteen eighty, he sits beside a dying Hollywood star. Steve McQueen.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":0.92}]
